messages.content:
# Rules

1. **Be respectful.** No harassment, slurs or personal attacks: criticize the project, not the person.
2. **One report per post.** Mods go to <#1560781769752445028>, the TCG tools and apps (TCGKB, PAB, OTO, CCV) to #app-tickets. Add the project's tag and the type that fits.
3. **Logs as files, not pasted.** Attach the log or the crash report, or share an mclo.gs link.
4. **No piracy or redistribution.** Don't share a mod or an app, or repack it, against its license.
5. **English in shared channels**, so everyone can follow along.

messages.content:
### 📦 How do I install a mod?
Download the file for **your loader** (Fabric or NeoForge) from Modrinth or CurseForge, drop it into your instance's `mods/` folder, and add the dependencies its page lists.
→ [Each mod's Getting Started](<https://manucruzleiva.github.io/mod-wiki/#the-mods>)

### 🧩 Which Minecraft and loader versions are supported?
<#1560884963967246506> lists every mod's current version, Minecraft version and loaders, read live from the stores. Pick the file that matches your loader.
→ [Each mod's requirements](<https://manucruzleiva.github.io/mod-wiki/#the-mods>)

### 🐛 How do I report a bug?
Open a post in <#1560781769752445028> with **the mod's tag** and a **type** (Bug, Crash, Idea, Feedback). Say what you did, what you expected and what happened, plus your mod version and loader. The bot files it and replies in your post.
→ [Reporting bugs & ideas](<https://manucruzleiva.github.io/mod-wiki/reporting/>)

### 📄 Where are `latest.log` and the crash reports?
In your game folder: `logs/latest.log` and `crash-reports/`. In a launcher, open the profile's folder (Modrinth App: ⋮ → **Open folder**). Attach the file to your post, or share an mclo.gs link.
→ [Where to find your logs](<https://manucruzleiva.github.io/mod-wiki/reporting/#where-to-find-your-logs>)

### 📋 How do I share my log with mclo.gs?
1. Open your log in a text editor: `logs/latest.log`, or the newest file in `crash-reports/` after a crash.
2. Copy all of it and paste it into <https://mclo.gs>.
3. Press **Save** and copy the link from your browser's address bar.
4. Paste that link into your post in <#1560781769752445028>.
→ [Where to find your logs](<https://manucruzleiva.github.io/mod-wiki/reporting/#where-to-find-your-logs>)

### 📝 Where is the changelog?
Every release is announced in <#1560858633049215047> with a summary, and its title links the full changelog. Each mod's whole history is on its Modrinth page, under **Changelog**.
→ [Each mod's page](<https://manucruzleiva.github.io/mod-wiki/#the-mods>)

messages.content:
# 📌 How to make a ticket
**This post is the example, and it is locked: open your own with the New Post button.** One post = one bug, crash, idea or piece of feedback.

## 1 · Pick two tags
- **What it is:** 🐛 Bug · 💥 Crash · 💡 Idea · 💬 Feedback
- **Which mod:** its tag — 🗺️ Routes, 🧺 Picnic, 💿 Ditto HMs… A post without a mod tag waits until it has one.

## 2 · Give us the crucial information
For a **bug** or a **crash**, this is what we need before we can start. Without it we cannot reproduce the problem, so the post gets the ❓ **Needs info** tag and waits until it arrives:
- **Minecraft version and the mod's version** (like `1.21.1` and `2.0.31`). A bug fixed in one version can still be there in an older one.
- **Your loader: Fabric or NeoForge.** Each has its own build of the mod, and a bug can live in only one of them.
- **Your log** — required for a crash, and it speeds up any bug. `logs/latest.log`, or the newest file in `crash-reports/` after a crash. It shows the exact error *and* every other mod you run, and another mod is often the real cause. Its first lines also say your versions and loader, so a log alone covers all three. Attach the file or paste an mclo.gs link: <#1532088850422305019> explains both.

## 3 · Copy the template for your kind of post
The messages below have one each. Copy it into your post, fill it in, and delete what does not apply.

The bot answers in your post: when it is tracked, when it is fixed, and when the fix is out.

### 🐛 Bug — something does not work as it should
Tags: **Bug** + the mod
```text
Title: what goes wrong, in a few words

What happened:
What I expected instead:
Steps to make it happen:
1.
2.
3.

Minecraft version:
Mod version:
Loader: Fabric / NeoForge
Log (recommended): attach logs/latest.log or paste an mclo.gs link
Screenshot or video (if it helps):
```

### 💥 Crash — the game closes or will not start
Tags: **Crash** + the mod
```text
Title: what you were doing when it crashed

What I was doing:
Does it happen every time? yes / no
Did it start after adding or updating a mod? Which one:

Minecraft version:
Mod version:
Loader: Fabric / NeoForge
Crash report (required): the newest file in crash-reports/, attached or as an mclo.gs link
No crash report? Attach logs/latest.log instead
```

### 💡 Idea — something the mod could do
Tags: **Idea** + the mod
```text
Title: the idea in a few words

What it would do:
Why it would help (what problem it solves):
How you would use it in your game:
```
No versions needed for an idea.

### 💬 Feedback — what you think of the mod
Tags: **Feedback** + the mod
```text
Title: what it is about

What I like or dislike:
What I would change, if anything:
Mod version (optional):
```
